name: David Keci
description: I am a software engineer focused on turning complex product ideas into reliable, intuitive applications. My work sits across frontend systems, backend services, and interaction design, with a strong preference for interfaces that feel fast, clear, and carefully finished.

On the frontend, I work with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Redux, Zustand, Vite, GSAP, and performance-minded rendering patterns. On the backend, I build with Spring Boot, Express.js, Python, REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, authentication flows, queues, and database-driven systems.

My professional experience includes freelance software development and engineering work at AE Distribution, where I built product features, optimized systems, and contributed to microservices architecture. I am currently studying Web Engineering at TU Chemnitz after completing a Software Engineering degree at Epoka University.

Alongside my studies and professional work, I build production-minded projects including restaurant management software, digital invitation systems, reproducibility tooling, and immersive learning experiences. I care about structure, details, and software that remains pleasant to use after the first impression.
